item.title: SCMaglev and Railway Park: Japan's Fastest Trains Up Close — Guide
item.description: The SCMaglev and Railway Park is JR Central’s superb railway museum on Nagoya’s port side, lining up 39 full-size vehicles that trace the evolution of Japanese rail speed — steam locomotives, early electric trains, generations of Shinkansen, and the superconducting maglev test car that set a world record of 581 km/h. Visitors can walk through cab and cabin interiors, drive train simulators including a Shinkansen cockpit, and linger over one of Japan’s largest railway dioramas, a miniature day-in-the-life of the Tokaido corridor that cycles from sunrise to night.
